_source: Verbatim strings for pototype/exec-audit.jsx ExecDashboard (L7-159) routed through the phrases bucket (tp). Kept in .json (the i18n-guard hook skips .json) so Thai never appears in .tsx/.ts source (B-073) — same pattern as dashboard-strings.json / boq-reports-strings.json. Every value is a REAL phrases key (tp) verified present in packages/i18n/src/i18n-full.json (phrases bucket, where the Thai phrase IS the key); the 22 net-new exec phrases landed in B-103 (be8885c). pctOfBudget / acceptSub carry {pct} / {value} placeholders filled by the view via String.replace (i18n has no interpolation, B-017). The KPI 'n types' sub composes a number with typeUnit ('ประเภท') like the mock's `${count} ประเภท`. Middot is U+00B7, em dash is U+2014, byte-exact with the prototype. The report DATA is LIVE from GET /analytics/portfolio; where a source is genuinely absent (accept-center counts/value, the executive-decisions rows) the view renders an honest em-dash / empty state and NO number is invented (C10 · PLAN.md section-0 rule 3).
